content: Contagion The Pandemic . Stand Alone  Book.   Teradyne is a small bio startup, deep in debt they are approached by the defense department, some of the partners are leery at taking a project from the military, but soon, in order to save the  company,  they have no choice.  The small company is soon given a wealth of data as the black ops of illegal bio-warfare opens to them taking them into the deep dark path of weapons research .  They are ill prepared for the research they are doing and soon something gets loose, a pathogen that quickly begins to spread through the population.  The story covers both sides, the government trying to protect the population and the military black ops trying to cover it up.  Disease Alters Humans Stripping them of their higher brain function they become like beasts, running in pacts and reverting to their  instincts,  attacking those without the virus and spreading  it.   John Marcos Machinist Ex-Military , now making engine blocks and upgrading performance cars.  He has just been elected mayor to the small southern town he lives in.  He is from up north causing animosity from the locals, he has enjoyed a simple life until now.  NOTES: These are notes on the book that I can add later as I think of things  John has to shore up the town after two attacks The federal government is a  shambles  and has gone into hiding.  They must fend for themselves  The town has to survive, think barter system,  Danger from plague and other people.  Gangs roam the roads.
